about: The single source of truth for vienna-districts besides the two Stadt Wien files (tools/README.md): the 23 districts and the water drawn on the map.
districts: number (BEZNR) and the official name; build_map.py checks each name against the source's NAMEK. Region ids are d01 … d23.

water: which water of Realnutzungskartierung 2024 (CODE 241) is drawn. Pieces closer than 20 m (edge to edge, any ring, or overlapping) form a body (a river cut by footbridges, a weir); a body is drawn if one of these seed points (EPSG:31256, metres) lies in one of its pieces. Wider bridges split a river into several bodies, each with its own seed; build_map.py patches the bridge gaps. A seed outside all water, or two seeds in one body, stops the build.

water_out: bodies within 60 m of drawn water that are deliberately not drawn, each by a point inside it. Any other body that close stops the build (after a re-pin a river split by a new gap would otherwise lose a piece silently): give it a seed or list it here. The names are only labels.

water_cut: single pieces taken out before anything else, each by a point inside it: ponds or basins that lie close to a river without being part of it, side arms and channels that only add noise. A cut piece never joins a body and never counts as near water.
